resources.string: Where you learn, study, and imitate.
Couldn\'t check for updates. Check the internet connection and try again.
Download it from GitHub and open the file to install it over this one; your work is kept.
Pick the folder that holds your book (or several books). Each folder inside it is shown as a card, and folders can hold more folders, e.g. a book with a folder for each chapter.
No folders or study files found here. Put PDF, Word or audio files in this folder, or in folders inside it, e.g. one for each book or chapter.
The book folder can no longer be read. Please choose it again.
Choose a file from the list
No app installed can open this file
Only the stylus writes; fingers scroll. Tap to let fingers write too.
Fingers write too. Tap so only the stylus writes.
☝ Finger: fingers write too — scroll with two fingers
✍ Stylus: only the stylus writes — fingers scroll
Only the stylus writes; fingers scroll.
Clear: erase the tracing on a page
Erase all your tracing on page %1$d?
Erase all your tracing on this document?
Clear the tracing on which page?
Write with a finger or stylus. Scroll and zoom with two fingers.
No %1$s voice is installed. Add it in Settings (⋮ on the main screen) → Download all.
The languages you\'re learning: Hok6 gets the voice and handwriting recognition for each. With more than one, Practice & Quiz has a switch between them.
Which voice engine Hok6 speaks with. Google\'s has voices for many languages; Hok6 uses it without changing the tablet\'s own setting.
Hok6 speaks with %1$s, which has voices for many languages. Your tablet\'s own voice engine, %2$s, stays as it is for other apps.\n\nYou can change this any time in Settings → Voices.
Hok6 now speaks with %1$s. The tablet\'s own voice setting hasn\'t changed.
Offer to download when a feature needs it
Hok6 works offline. The dictionary is built in; handwriting recognition and the voices come from the internet once.

Turn on Wi-Fi and tap Download all. Handwriting downloads here. Voices already work with internet; to have them offline too, Download all opens Google\'s voice screen: add the voice for each language you\'re learning, then come back. You can skip and download any time in Settings.
Couldn\'t download. Check Wi-Fi and try again.
Works with internet only: Download all adds it for offline use
Not installed yet: Download all opens where to add it
Install Speech Services by Google, then come back to Hok6 and tap Download all again.
Set the preferred engine to Speech Services by Google, then ⚙ → Install voice data → the voice for each language you\'re learning.
Download the voice for each language you\'re learning, then come back to Hok6.
Hearing words needs a %1$s voice. Android adds voices in its own settings; Hok6 will open the right screen for you.

Next, Android shows the folders on this device. Open the folder that holds your book, tap Use this folder, then Allow.\n\nChanged your mind? Press Back there until you\'re back in Hok6 (each press first goes up a folder); nothing changes.

Your book folder now:
%1$s

Next, Android shows the folders on this device: open another folder, tap Use this folder, then Allow. To keep the one you have, press Back there until you're back in Hok6 (each press first goes up a folder).
Changed your mind? Press Back until you\'re back in Hok6
Tap the characters you want to practice.
From page %1$d of %2$d only, not the whole file
From the paragraph you tapped, not the whole document
No characters to practice were found on this page.
This page is an image, so the characters were recognised from it — check they\'re right. Tap the ones you want to practice.
Reading the characters on this page…
The selection has no characters to practice
Practice Selector (tap a character to practice writing it)
Practice Selector: tap a character to choose from the characters on that page. Tap the pen to write again.
Backup saved. Keep a copy off the tablet too (e.g. on a computer) to restore after reinstalling.

This book folder has a Hok6 backup (%1$s). Restore it to bring back your practice history, writing, tracing and quiz? It\'s added to anything already in Hok6.\n\nIf you don\'t restore it, it\'s replaced by a backup of your work from now on.
Hok6 now keeps a backup of your work in your book folder (Hok6 backup.json), so it\'s safe if Hok6 is removed.\n\nTap Choose folder, pick the same book folder again, then tap Allow.
Restored: %1$d words in history, tracing on %2$d files
That file isn\'t a Hok6 backup
Folder name, e.g. Chapter 3 or Book 2
A name can\'t start with a dot or contain / \\ : * ? \" < > |
There is already a folder called %1$s
Not moved, because %1$s already has a file with the same name:\n%2$s
To move files and make folders, Hok6 needs permission to change your book folder.\n\nTap Choose folder, pick the same book folder again, then tap Allow.
That\'s a different folder. Choose your book folder to allow changes.
Save a copy with my tracing…
A new PDF with your tracing drawn in is saved in this folder. The original isn\'t changed.
Nothing traced on this file yet
%1$s is already in this folder. Replace it?\n\nWhat\'s in it now, and any tracing on it, will be lost.
%1$s is the file you\'re working on. Replacing it draws your tracing into the page for good: it can\'t be erased or undone afterwards.
Added %1$d to the quiz (%2$d in it now). Open Practice & Quiz → Quiz.
